q: अंतर्राष्ट्रीय बुकर पुरस्कार 2026 जीतने वाले उपन्यास 'ताइवान ट्रैवलॉग' (Taiwan Travelogue) की लेखिका कौन हैं?
e: Taiwanese author Yáng Shuāng-zǐ authored *Taiwan Travelogue*, winner of the International Booker Prize 2026. (ताइवानी लेखिका यांग शुआंग-ज़ी ने 'ताइवान ट्रैवलॉग' की रचना की, जिसने अंतर्राष्ट्रीय बुकर पुरस्कार 2026 जीता।) Exam Booster Facts: (1) Han Kang (South Korea) won the 2024 Nobel Prize in Literature; (2) Jenny Erpenbeck won the 2024 International Booker Prize for *Kairos*; (3) Geetanjali Shree (*Ret Samadhi*) became the first Hindi author to win the International Booker Prize in 2022; (4) The Booker Prize (original) is for English-language novels, while the International Booker honours translated fiction.
qe: Who is the author of the novel *Taiwan Travelogue*, which won the International Booker Prize 2026?

q: प्रख्यात पार्श्वगायिका अलका याग्निक और प्रसिद्ध अभिनेता ममूटी को वर्ष 2026 में किस प्रतिष्ठित राष्ट्रीय नागरिक सम्मान से सम्मानित किया गया?
e: Alka Yagnik (Art) and Mammootty (Art) were conferred the Padma Bhushan 2026, alongside Uday Kotak (Trade & Industry) and Shibu Soren (Public Affairs, Posthumous). (अलका याग्निक व ममूटी को कला के क्षेत्र में पद्म भूषण 2026 से सम्मानित किया गया।) Exam Booster Facts: (1) Padma Awards are conferred by the President of India at Rashtrapati Bhavan; (2) The three categories in descending order are Padma Vibhushan, Padma Bhushan, and Padma Shri; (3) Total Padma Awards conferred in a year (excluding posthumous/foreigners) normally do not exceed 120; (4) First Padma Awards were presented in 1954.
qe: Veteran playback singer Alka Yagnik and acclaimed actor Mammootty were honoured with which prestigious national civilian award in 2026?

q: अक्टूबर 2026 में केंद्रीय मंत्रिमंडल द्वारा प्रधानमंत्री सामाजिक सहायता योजना के लिए कुल कितना वित्तीय परिव्यय स्वीकृत किया गया?
e: The Union Cabinet approved ₹53,428 crore in October 2026 for the Pradhan Mantri Samajik Sahayata Yojana to expand direct social security coverage for elderly, widowed, and disabled citizens. (अक्टूबर 2026 में केंद्रीय मंत्रिमंडल ने प्रधानमंत्री सामाजिक सहायता योजना हेतु ₹53,428 करोड़ की स्वीकृति दी।) Exam Booster Facts: (1) Social security pensions are administered at the central level by the Ministry of Rural Development (NSAP); (2) Article 41 of the Constitution directs the State to provide public assistance in cases of old age, sickness, and disablement; (3) Atal Pension Yojana (APY, 2015) provides guaranteed pension for unorganized sector workers aged 18–40; (4) PM-SYM targets unorganized workers with monthly income up to ₹15,000.
qe: What is the total financial outlay approved by the Union Cabinet in October 2026 for the Pradhan Mantri Samajik Sahayata Yojana?

q:
अक्टूबर 2026 में स्वीकृत 'SIOFA' में भारत के सम्मिलित होने के संबंध में निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार कीजिए:
कथन I: SIOFA का पूर्ण रूप 'सदर्न इंडियन ओशन फिशरीज़ एग्रीमेंट' है।
कथन II: इसका उद्देश्य दक्षिणी हिंद महासागर के उच्च समुद्र में मत्स्य संसाधनों का दीर्घकालिक संरक्षण और सतत प्रबंधन करना है।
उपर्युक्त में से कौन-सा/से कथन सही है/हैं?
o: न तो कथन I और न ही कथन II
कथन I और कथन II दोनों
e: Both statements are correct. India's accession to the Southern Indian Ocean Fisheries Agreement (SIOFA) in October 2026 strengthens its role in sustainable deep-sea fisheries governance in the Indian Ocean. (दोनों कथन सही हैं; SIOFA दक्षिणी हिंद महासागर में सतत मत्स्य प्रबंधन हेतु अंतर्राष्ट्रीय समझौता है।) Exam Booster Facts: (1) Under UNCLOS (1982), a coastal nation's Exclusive Economic Zone (EEZ) extends up to 200 nautical miles; (2) Beyond 200 nautical miles lie the High Seas, governed by regional fisheries management organizations like SIOFA and IOTC; (3) Blue Revolution (Neeli Kranti) relates to fisheries production; (4) India is among the top 3 fish-producing nations globally.
qe:
Consider the following statements regarding India's accession to SIOFA (approved in October 2026):
Statement I: SIOFA stands for Southern Indian Ocean Fisheries Agreement.
Statement II: It aims to promote long-term conservation and sustainable management of fishery resources in the Southern Indian Ocean high seas.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
oe: Neither Statement I nor Statement II
Both Statement I and Statement II

q: अक्टूबर 2026 में युद्धपोत 'मांगरोल' के जलावतरण/कमीशनिंग के साथ स्वदेशी फ्लीट सपोर्ट शिप 'सूर्या' का जलावतरण किस बंदरगाह शहर में किया गया?
e: The indigenous Fleet Support Ship 'Surya' was launched in Visakhapatnam (Andhra Pradesh) in October 2026, alongside the commissioning of warship 'Mangrol'. (अक्टूबर 2026 में स्वदेशी फ्लीट सपोर्ट शिप 'सूर्या' का विशाखापत्तनम में जलावतरण किया गया।) Exam Booster Facts: (1) Hindustan Shipyard Limited (HSL), founded in 1941, is located at Visakhapatnam; (2) Mazagon Dock Shipbuilders Limited (MDL) is in Mumbai, and Garden Reach Shipbuilders (GRSE) is in Kolkata; (3) Cochin Shipyard Limited (Kochi) built India's first indigenous aircraft carrier INS Vikrant; (4) Visakhapatnam is India's deepest landlocked natural port.
qe: In October 2026, the indigenous Fleet Support Ship 'Surya' was launched at which port city, alongside the commissioning of warship 'Mangrol'?

q: अक्टूबर 2026 में मणिपुर ने बहुभाषी एआई (AI) विकास हेतु भारत सरकार के किस डिजिटल प्लेटफॉर्म के साथ समझौता किया?
e: Manipur partnered with 'BHASHINI' (BHASHa INterface for India) in October 2026 to develop AI-powered voice and text translation tools for regional languages. (अक्टूबर 2026 में मणिपुर ने बहुभाषी AI विकास के लिए 'भाषिणी' प्लेटफॉर्म के साथ समझौता किया।) Exam Booster Facts: (1) BHASHINI operates under the National Language Translation Mission (MeitY); (2) DIKSHA is the national school education portal; (3) UMANG aggregates central/state e-governance services; (4) DigiLocker provides authentic digital documents linked to Aadhaar.
qe: In October 2026, Manipur signed a pact with which Government of India digital platform for multilingual AI development?

q: उत्तर प्रदेश का कौन-सा नगर प्रसिद्ध रूप से 'भारत की इत्र नगरी' (Perfume Capital of India) के रूप में जाना जाता है?
e: Kannauj (ancient Kanyakubja, capital of Harshavardhana) is renowned for traditional hydro-distillation attar (perfume) manufacturing and is GI-tagged under UP's ODOP scheme. (कन्नौज को भारत की इत्र नगरी कहा जाता है और यह सम्राट हर्षवर्धन की राजधानी भी रहा है।) Exam Booster Facts: (1) 'Siraj-e-Hind' (शीराज़-ए-हिंद) is the historical title of Jaunpur (founded by Firoz Shah Tughlaq); (2) Firozabad is the 'Glass City' (सुहाग नगरी); (3) Aligarh is the 'Lock City' (ताला नगरी); (4) Meerut is famous for sports goods and scissors ('क्रांति नगरी').
qe: Which city of Uttar Pradesh is famously known as the 'Perfume Capital of India' (इत्र नगरी)?

q: स्वतंत्रता के पश्चात् उत्तर प्रदेश के प्रथम मुख्यमंत्री कौन थे?
e: Pandit Govind Ballabh Pant served as the first Chief Minister of Uttar Pradesh (1950–1954) and later became India's Union Home Minister (awarded Bharat Ratna in 1957). (पं. गोविन्द बल्लभ पंत उत्तर प्रदेश के प्रथम मुख्यमंत्री थे, जिन्हें 1957 में भारत रत्न मिला।) Exam Booster Facts: (1) Sarojini Naidu was the first Governor of UP (and first woman Governor in India); (2) Sucheta Kripalani was the first woman Chief Minister of UP and India (1963–67); (3) Purushottam Das Tandon was the first Speaker of the UP Legislative Assembly; (4) UP has a bicameral legislature: 403 Vidhan Sabha seats and 100 Vidhan Parishad seats.
qe: Who was the first Chief Minister of Uttar Pradesh after India's independence?

q:
सूची-I (उ.प्र. विरासत स्थल) को सूची-II (जिला) से सुमेलित कीजिए और सही कूट चुनिए:
सूची-I: (1) सारनाथ स्तूप, (2) महापरिनिर्वाण मंदिर, (3) भीतरगाँव ईंट मंदिर, (4) दशावतार मंदिर (देवगढ़)
सूची-II: (a) ललितपुर, (b) कानपुर नगर, (c) वाराणसी, (d) कुशीनगर
e: Sarnath (Dhamek Stupa) — Varanasi (1-c); Mahaparinirvana Temple — Kushinagar (2-d); Gupta-era Bhitargaon Brick Temple — Kanpur Nagar (3-b); Gupta-era Dashavatara Temple (Deogarh) — Lalitpur (4-a). (सारनाथ-वाराणसी, महापरिनिर्वाण-कुशीनगर, भीतरगाँव-कानपुर, दशावतार-ललितपुर; अतः 1-c, 2-d, 3-b, 4-a।) Exam Booster Facts: (1) Bhitargaon Temple is one of the oldest surviving terracotta/brick temples of the Gupta period; (2) Deogarh's Dashavatara Temple is famous for its Panchayatan style and Sheshashayi Vishnu relief; (3) UP has 3 UNESCO World Heritage Sites: Taj Mahal, Agra Fort, and Fatehpur Sikri; (4) Shravasti (Jetavana) is where Buddha spent the maximum number of monsoon retreats (Varshavasa).
qe:
Match List-I (UP Cultural Institution / Heritage Site) with List-II (District) and choose the correct code:
List-I: (1) Sarnath Stupa, (2) Kushinagar Mahaparinirvana Temple, (3) Bhitargaon Brick Temple, (4) Dashavatara Temple (Deogarh)
List-II: (a) Lalitpur, (b) Kanpur Nagar, (c) Varanasi, (d) Kushinagar

q: उत्तर प्रदेश के भूगोल और प्रशासनिक संरचना के संबंध में निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा कथन सही नहीं है?
o: उत्तर प्रदेश 18 मंडलों और 75 जिलों में विभाजित है
क्षेत्रफल की दृष्टि से लखीमपुर खीरी उ.प्र. का सबसे बड़ा जिला है
क्षेत्रफल की दृष्टि से हापुड़ उ.प्र. का सबसे छोटा जिला है
उत्तर प्रदेश से लोकसभा में 75 और राज्यसभा में 31 सदस्य चुने जाते हैं
e: Statement D is incorrect because Uttar Pradesh sends 80 members to the Lok Sabha (highest in India) and 31 members to the Rajya Sabha, NOT 75. All other statements are correct. (कथन D गलत है; उत्तर प्रदेश से लोकसभा की 80 सीटें तथा राज्यसभा की 31 सीटें हैं, न कि 75।) Exam Booster Facts: (1) UP's 18th administrative division is Aligarh (created in 2008); (2) Prayagraj is the most populous district of UP (Census 2011), while Mahoba is the least populous; (3) State Animal: Barasingha (Swamp Deer), State Bird: Sarus Crane, State Tree: Ashoka, State Flower: Palash; (4) UP's High Court is at Prayagraj (established 1866) with its bench at Lucknow.
qe: Which of the following statements about Uttar Pradesh's geography and administrative structure is NOT correct?
oe: Uttar Pradesh is divided into 18 administrative divisions and 75 districts
Lakhimpur Kheri is the largest district of UP by geographical area
Hapur is the smallest district of UP by geographical area
Uttar Pradesh sends 75 members to the Lok Sabha and 31 members to the Rajya Sabha

q: हिंदुस्तानी शास्त्रीय संगीत का प्रमुख संस्थान 'भातखंडे संस्कृति विश्वविद्यालय' (पूर्व नाम: भातखंडे संगीत संस्थान) उत्तर प्रदेश के किस शहर में स्थित है?
e: Founded in 1926 by Pandit Vishnu Narayan Bhatkhande as Marris College of Music, Bhatkhande Sanskriti Vishwavidyalaya is located in Lucknow. (1926 में पं. विष्णु नारायण भातखंडे द्वारा स्थापित यह संस्थान लखनऊ में स्थित है।) Exam Booster Facts: (1) Bharatendu Natya Akademi (1975) and State Lalit Kala Akademi (1962) are also in Lucknow; (2) National Kathak Institute (1988–89) is in Lucknow; (3) North Central Zone Cultural Centre (NCZCC) is located in Prayagraj; (4) Amir Khusrau (born at Patiyali, Kasganj, UP) is credited with inventing the Sitar, Tabla, and Khayal/Qawwali.
qe: The 'Bhatkhande Sanskriti Vishwavidyalaya' (formerly Bhatkhande Music Institute), India's premier Hindustani classical music institution, is located in which city of Uttar Pradesh?

q: "स्वराज मेरा जन्मसिद्ध अधिकार है और मैं इसे लेकर रहूँगा" — यह प्रसिद्ध उद्घोष किसने दिया था?
e: Lokmanya Bal Gangadhar Tilak gave this iconic slogan during the Home Rule League Movement (1916). (लोकमान्य बाल गंगाधर तिलक ने 1916 के होमरूल आंदोलन के दौरान यह नारा दिया था।) Exam Booster Facts: (1) Tilak published 'Kesari' (in Marathi) and 'Mahratta' (in English); (2) He wrote 'Gita Rahasya' in Mandalay Jail (Burma) and 'The Arctic Home in the Vedas'; (3) He popularized Ganesh Utsav (1893) and Shivaji Festival (1895) to foster nationalism; (4) Valentine Chirol called Tilak the "Father of Indian Unrest".
qe: Who gave the famous clarion call "Swaraj is my birthright and I shall have it"?

q: 1793 ई. में बंगाल, बिहार और ओडिशा में भू-राजस्व का 'स्थायी बंदोबस्त' (जमींदारी प्रथा) किस गवर्नर-जनरल द्वारा लागू किया गया था?
e: Lord Cornwallis introduced the Permanent Settlement in 1793 (planned with Sir John Shore), recognizing Zamindars as hereditary owners of land paying fixed revenue to the Company. (लॉर्ड कॉर्नवालिस ने 1793 में स्थायी बंदोबस्त लागू किया; उन्हें भारत में सिविल सेवा का जनक भी कहा जाता है।) Exam Booster Facts: (1) Ryotwari System was introduced by Thomas Munro and Alexander Read in Madras/Bombay (~51% area); (2) Mahalwari System was introduced by Holt Mackenzie (1822) and R.M. Bird in North-Western Provinces (UP/Punjab); (3) Lord Cornwallis's tomb is located in Ghazipur (Uttar Pradesh); (4) Warren Hastings was the first Governor-General of Bengal (Regulating Act, 1773).
qe: The 'Permanent Settlement' (स्थायी बंदोबस्त / Zamindari System) of land revenue was introduced in Bengal, Bihar, and Odisha in 1793 by which Governor-General?

q: सितंबर 1928 में दिल्ली के फिरोजशाह कोटला में पुनर्गठित 'हिंदुस्तान सोशलिस्ट रिपब्लिकन एसोसिएशन' (HSRA) के प्रमुख संस्थापक कौन थे?
e: Chandra Shekhar Azad, Bhagat Singh, Sukhdev, and Rajguru reorganized the earlier HRA (founded in Kanpur, 1924 by Sachindra Sanyal & Bismil) into HSRA in September 1928 at Feroz Shah Kotla, Delhi. (चंद्रशेखर आज़ाद और भगत सिंह ने 1928 में दिल्ली के फिरोजशाह कोटला में HSRA का गठन किया।) Exam Booster Facts: (1) Bhagat Singh and Batukeshwar Dutt threw harmless bombs in the Central Legislative Assembly on 8 April 1929 against the Public Safety & Trade Disputes Bills; (2) Bhagat Singh, Sukhdev, and Rajguru were martyred on 23 March 1931 (Shaheed Diwas); (3) Chandra Shekhar Azad attained martyrdom on 27 February 1931 at Alfred Park (now Azad Park), Prayagraj; (4) Bhagat Singh founded the Naujawan Bharat Sabha (1926) and wrote "Why I Am an Atheist".
qe: Who was the founder of the 'Hindustan Socialist Republican Association' (HSRA) reorganized at Feroz Shah Kotla, Delhi in September 1928?
oe: Ram Prasad Bismil and Ashfaqulla Khan
Chandra Shekhar Azad and Bhagat Singh
Ras Behari Bose and Sachindra Sanyal

q:
सूची-I (प्राचीन भारतीय ग्रंथ) को सूची-II (लेखक) से सुमेलित कीजिए और सही कूट चुनिए:
सूची-I: (1) अष्टाध्यायी, (2) महाभाष्य, (3) इंडिका, (4) बुद्धचरित
सूची-II: (a) अश्वघोष, (b) मेगस्थनीज़, (c) पतंजलि, (d) पाणिनि
e: Ashtadhyayi (Sanskrit grammar) — Panini (1-d); Mahabhashya — Patanjali (2-c); Indica — Megasthenes, Seleucid envoy at Chandragupta Maurya's court (3-b); Buddha Charita — Ashvaghosha, court poet of Kanishka (4-a). (अष्टाध्यायी-पाणिनि, महाभाष्य-पतंजलि, इंडिका-मेगस्थनीज़, बुद्धचरित-अश्वघोष; अतः 1-d, 2-c, 3-b, 4-a।) Exam Booster Facts: (1) Patanjali was a contemporary of Pushyamitra Shunga and also authored the Yoga Sutras; (2) Katyayana wrote 'Varttika' on Panini's Ashtadhyayi (Panini, Katyayana, Patanjali = Munitraya); (3) Fa-Hien visited India during Chandragupta II (Vikramaditya), while Hiuen Tsang visited during Harshavardhana; (4) 'Sushruta Samhita' is the ancient treatise on surgery and 'Charaka Samhita' on medicine.
qe:
Match List-I (Ancient Indian Text) with List-II (Author) and select the correct code:
List-I: (1) Ashtadhyayi, (2) Mahabhashya, (3) Indica, (4) Buddha Charita
List-II: (a) Ashvaghosha, (b) Megasthenes, (c) Patanjali, (d) Panini

q: भारत शासन अधिनियम, 1935 के संबंध में निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा कथन सही नहीं है?
o: इसने प्रांतों में द्वैध शासन समाप्त कर प्रांतीय स्वायत्तता प्रारंभ की
इसने दिल्ली में संघीय न्यायालय (1937) की स्थापना का प्रावधान किया
इसने केंद्र में द्वैध शासन का प्रावधान किया
इसने भारत को तत्काल डोमिनियन स्टेटस और पूर्ण स्वतंत्रता प्रदान की
e: The Government of India Act, 1935 did NOT grant Dominion Status or independence (which came via the Indian Independence Act, 1947). All other three features—Provincial Autonomy, Federal Court (1937), and Dyarchy at the Centre—were part of the 1935 Act. (1935 के अधिनियम ने डोमिनियन स्टेटस या स्वतंत्रता नहीं दी; अन्य तीनों प्रावधान इस अधिनियम का हिस्सा थे।) Exam Booster Facts: (1) Dyarchy in provinces was earlier introduced by the Government of India Act, 1919 (Montagu-Chelmsford Reforms); (2) The 1935 Act also led to the establishment of the Reserve Bank of India (1935) and separated Burma from India (1937); (3) Over 250 provisions of the Indian Constitution were adapted from the 1935 Act; (4) Communal electorates were first introduced by the Indian Councils Act, 1909 (Morley-Minto Reforms).
qe: Which of the following statements regarding the Government of India Act, 1935 is NOT correct?
oe: It abolished Dyarchy in the provinces and introduced Provincial Autonomy
It provided for the establishment of a Federal Court in Delhi (1937)
It introduced Dyarchy at the Centre
It granted immediate Dominion Status and complete independence to India

q: भारतीय संविधान की किस अनुसूची में भारत की 22 मान्यता प्राप्त भाषाओं की सूची दी गई है?
e: The Eighth Schedule of the Indian Constitution lists 22 recognized languages (originally 14, expanded via the 21st, 71st, and 92nd Amendments). (संविधान की आठवीं अनुसूची में 22 मान्यता प्राप्त भाषाएँ सूचीबद्ध हैं।) Exam Booster Facts: (1) Seventh Schedule divides powers into Union, State, and Concurrent Lists; (2) Ninth Schedule (1st Amendment, 1951) protects land reform laws; (3) Tenth Schedule (52nd Amendment, 1985) deals with Anti-Defection; (4) English is NOT listed in the Eighth Schedule, though it is an associate official language under the Official Languages Act, 1963.
qe: Which Schedule of the Indian Constitution contains the list of 22 recognized official languages of India?

q: भारतीय संविधान के किस अनुच्छेद के अंतर्गत राष्ट्रपति किसी राज्य में संवैधानिक तंत्र की विफलता पर 'राष्ट्रपति शासन' (राज्य आपातकाल) लागू कर सकते हैं?
e: Article 356 empowers the President to proclaim President's Rule in a State upon receiving a Governor's report or otherwise being satisfied that governance cannot be carried on per the Constitution. (अनुच्छेद 356 के अंतर्गत राज्यों में राष्ट्रपति शासन लगाया जाता है।) Exam Booster Facts: (1) Article 352 deals with National Emergency (War, External Aggression, or Armed Rebellion — replaced 'Internal Disturbance' via 44th Amendment, 1978); (2) Article 360 deals with Financial Emergency (never imposed in India); (3) Article 368 provides the procedure for Constitutional Amendment; (4) S.R. Bommai Case (1994) established judicial review over Article 356 proclamations.
qe: Under which Article of the Indian Constitution can the President impose 'President's Rule' (State Emergency) in a State on the failure of constitutional machinery?

q: राष्ट्रीय शिक्षा नीति (NEP) 2020 के अंतर्गत वर्ष 2030 तक पूरे भारत में विद्यालयी शिक्षण के लिए न्यूनतम डिग्री योग्यता क्या होगी?
o: किसी भी विषय में स्नातकोत्तर डिग्री
e: NEP 2020 mandates that by 2030, the minimum degree qualification for teaching will be a 4-year Integrated Teacher Education Programme (ITEP — dual-major holistic Bachelor's degree). (NEP 2020 के अनुसार वर्ष 2030 तक शिक्षण हेतु न्यूनतम योग्यता 4 वर्षीय एकीकृत बी.एड. (ITEP) होगी।) Exam Booster Facts: (1) NEP 2020 also mandates 50 hours of Continuous Professional Development (CPD) per year for every teacher; (2) National Professional Standards for Teachers (NPST) are being developed by NCTE; (3) Teachers will be recruited through strengthened TETs covering all stages (Foundational, Preparatory, Middle, Secondary); (4) National Mission for Mentoring (NMM) pairs senior/retired faculty with teachers.
qe: Under the National Education Policy (NEP) 2020, what will be the minimum degree qualification for school teaching across India by the year 2030?

q:
भारतीय संविधान के राजभाषा प्रावधानों (भाग XVII) के संबंध में निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार कीजिए:
कथन I: अनुच्छेद 344 राजभाषा आयोग की सिफारिशों की जाँच हेतु 30 सदस्यों (20 लोकसभा व 10 राज्यसभा) की संसदीय समिति के गठन का प्रावधान करता है।
कथन II: अनुच्छेद 348 के अंतर्गत, जब तक संसद अन्यथा उपबंध न करे, सर्वोच्च न्यायालय और प्रत्येक उच्च न्यायालय की सभी कार्यवाही अंग्रेजी भाषा में होगी।
उपर्युक्त में से कौन-सा/से कथन सही है/हैं?
o: न तो कथन I और न ही कथन II
कथन I और कथन II दोनों
e: Both statements are completely accurate as per Articles 344(4) and 348(1) of the Constitution. (दोनों कथन सत्य हैं; अनुच्छेद 344(4) में 30 सदस्यीय संसदीय राजभाषा समिति तथा अनुच्छेद 348(1) में उच्चतम व उच्च न्यायालयों की भाषा अंग्रेजी निर्धारित है।) Exam Booster Facts: (1) Under Article 348(2), a State Governor may, with the President's previous consent, authorize the use of Hindi/state official language in High Court proceedings (authorized in UP, Bihar, MP, Rajasthan — excluding judgments/decrees); (2) First Official Language Commission (1955) was chaired by B.G. Kher; (3) First Parliamentary Committee on Official Language (1957) was chaired by Govind Ballabh Pant; (4) Official Languages Act was enacted in 1963.
qe:
Consider the following statements regarding the Official Language provisions (Part XVII) of the Indian Constitution:
Statement I: Article 344 provides for the constitution of a Parliamentary Committee of 30 members (20 from Lok Sabha and 10 from Rajya Sabha) to examine the recommendations of the Official Language Commission.
Statement II: Under Article 348, until Parliament provides otherwise, all proceedings in the Supreme Court and every High Court shall be in the English language.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
oe: Neither Statement I nor Statement II
Both Statement I and Statement II

q: किस ऐतिहासिक सर्वोच्च न्यायालय के निर्णय ने भारतीय संविधान के 'मूल ढाँचे के सिद्धांत' (Basic Structure Doctrine) का प्रतिपादन किया कि संसद अनुच्छेद 368 के तहत संविधान के मूल लक्षणों को नष्ट नहीं कर सकती?
e: In Kesavananda Bharati vs. State of Kerala (24 April 1973), India's largest-ever 13-judge Constitution Bench ruled (7:6) that Parliament can amend any part of the Constitution but cannot alter its 'Basic Structure'. (24 अप्रैल 1973 को 13 न्यायाधीशों की पीठ ने केशवानंद भारती वाद में 'मूल ढाँचे के सिद्धांत' का प्रतिपादन किया।) Exam Booster Facts: (1) Key elements of Basic Structure include Supremacy of Constitution, Secularism, Federalism, Judicial Review, Free & Fair Elections, and Harmony between FRs & DPSPs (Minerva Mills, 1980); (2) Maneka Gandhi Case (1978) expanded Article 21 to include 'Due Process of Law' (fair, just, and reasonable procedure); (3) Golaknath (1967) had earlier ruled Parliament could not amend Fundamental Rights; (4) Justice S.M. Sikri was the Chief Justice of India during Kesavananda Bharati.
qe: Which landmark Supreme Court judgment propounded the 'Basic Structure Doctrine' of the Indian Constitution, holding that Parliament cannot destroy the basic features of the Constitution under Article 368?
oe: Kesavananda Bharati vs. State of Kerala (1973)

q: भारत के किस राज्य की मुख्य भूमि की तटरेखा सबसे लंबी है?
e: Gujarat has the longest mainland coastline in India (~1,214 km), followed by Andhra Pradesh (~974 km) and Tamil Nadu (~907 km). (भारत में गुजरात की मुख्य भूमि की तटरेखा सबसे लंबी है, जिसके बाद आंध्र प्रदेश और तमिलनाडु का स्थान है।) Exam Booster Facts: (1) Including islands (Andaman & Nicobar, Lakshadweep), India's total coastline is ~7,516.6 km; (2) 9 Indian states have coastlines: Gujarat, Maharashtra, Goa, Karnataka, Kerala, Tamil Nadu, Andhra Pradesh, Odisha, and West Bengal; (3) Goa has the shortest coastline among Indian states; (4) Eastern coast is called Coromandel (TN/AP) and Northern Circars (Odisha/AP), while Western coast includes Konkan, Kanara, and Malabar.
qe: Which Indian state has the LONGEST mainland coastline?

q: एशिया का सबसे बड़ा खारे पानी का लैगून और भारत का पहला रामसर आर्द्रभूमि स्थल (1981) 'चिल्का झील' किस राज्य में स्थित है?
e: Chilika Lake (famous for Irrawaddy dolphins and migratory birds at Nalabana Island) is located in Odisha; it and Keoladeo National Park (Rajasthan) were India's first two Ramsar sites designated in 1981. (चिल्का झील ओडिशा में स्थित है और 1981 में केवलादेव राष्ट्रीय उद्यान के साथ भारत की पहली रामसर साइट बनी।) Exam Booster Facts: (1) Wular Lake (J&K, fed by Jhelum) is India's largest freshwater lake; (2) Sambhar Lake (Rajasthan) is India's largest inland saltwater lake; (3) Pulicat Lake lies on the Andhra Pradesh–Tamil Nadu border (Sriharikota island separates it from Bay of Bengal); (4) Ramsar Convention on Wetlands was signed on 2 February 1971 in Iran (2 Feb = World Wetlands Day).
qe: 'Chilika Lake', Asia's largest brackish water lagoon and India's first Ramsar Wetland site (1981), is located in which state?

q: भारत की प्रमुख नदी घाटी परियोजनाओं और संबंधित नदियों का निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा युग्म सही सुमेलित नहीं है?
e: Nagarjuna Sagar Dam (Telangana–Andhra Pradesh border) is built on the KRISHNA river, NOT the Godavari river. All other three pairs are correctly matched. (नागार्जुन सागर बाँध कृष्णा नदी पर बना है, न कि गोदावरी पर; अन्य तीनों युग्म सही हैं।) Exam Booster Facts: (1) Tehri Dam (Uttarakhand, 260.5 m) on the Bhagirathi is India's tallest dam; (2) Hirakud Dam (Odisha) on the Mahanadi is India's longest earthen dam; (3) Mettur Dam (TN) and Krishna Raja Sagara Dam (Karnataka) are on the Kaveri river; (4) Damodar Valley Corporation (DVC, 1948) was Independent India's first multipurpose river valley project (modeled on USA's TVA).
qe: Which of the following pairs of Indian river valley projects and the rivers on which they are built is NOT correctly matched?

q: भारत की किस पंचवर्षीय योजना में "गरीबी हटाओ" का प्रसिद्ध नारा दिया गया तथा गरीबी उन्मूलन और आत्मनिर्भरता पर बल दिया गया?
e: The Fifth Five-Year Plan (1974–1978, drafted by D.P. Dhar) explicitly targeted poverty eradication ('Garibi Hatao') and self-reliance; it was terminated a year early in 1978 by the Janata Government. (पाँचवीं पंचवर्षीय योजना (1974–78) में गरीबी उन्मूलन ('गरीबी हटाओ') और आत्मनिर्भरता को मुख्य लक्ष्य बनाया गया।) Exam Booster Facts: (1) First Plan (1951–56) was based on the Harrod-Domar Model (focus: agriculture); (2) Second Plan (1956–61) was based on the P.C. Mahalanobis Model (focus: heavy industry); (3) 1966–69 was the 'Plan Holiday' (3 annual plans) during which the Green Revolution began; (4) 1991 Economic Reforms (LPG — Liberalisation, Privatisation, Globalisation) took place before the 8th Plan (1992–97).
qe: Which Five-Year Plan of India gave the famous slogan "Garibi Hatao" (Remove Poverty) and focused on poverty alleviation and self-reliance?

q: भारत में प्रमुख कृषि फसलों के लिए न्यूनतम समर्थन मूल्य (MSP) की औपचारिक सिफारिश भारत सरकार को किस संस्था द्वारा की जाती है?
e: The Commission for Agricultural Costs and Prices (CACP, originally Agricultural Prices Commission established in 1965) recommends MSPs for 22 mandated crops (plus Fair and Remunerative Price / FRP for sugarcane), which are finally approved by the Cabinet Committee on Economic Affairs (CCEA). (कृषि लागत और मूल्य आयोग (CACP) MSP की सिफारिश करता है और आर्थिक मामलों की मंत्रिमंडलीय समिति (CCEA) अंतिम मंजूरी देती है।) Exam Booster Facts: (1) FCI (established 1965) handles procurement, buffer stocking, and PDS distribution; (2) M.S. Swaminathan is known as the Father of India's Green Revolution (Bharat Ratna 2024); (3) Verghese Kurien is the Father of India's White Revolution (Operation Flood, 1970); (4) e-NAM (2016) integrates agricultural APMCs across India digitally.
qe: In India, the Minimum Support Price (MSP) for major agricultural crops is formally recommended to the Government of India by which body?
oe: Commission for Agricultural Costs and Prices (CACP)

q: अंतर्राष्ट्रीय व्यापार एवं मौद्रिक अर्थशास्त्र में घरेलू मुद्रा का 'अवमूल्यन' (Devaluation) सामान्यतः किस प्रवृत्ति को बढ़ावा देता है?
o: निर्यात को महँगा और आयात को सस्ता बनाता है
विदेशी खरीदारों के लिए निर्यात को सस्ता और घरेलू स्तर पर आयात को महँगा बनाता है
निर्यात और आयात दोनों को समान रूप से कम करता है
घरेलू मुद्रास्फीति को तुरंत समाप्त कर देता है
e: Devaluation lowers the external value of a currency relative to foreign currencies, making domestic goods cheaper for foreign buyers (boosting exports) and foreign goods costlier for domestic buyers (discouraging imports). (मुद्रा अवमूल्यन से विदेशियों के लिए भारतीय वस्तुएँ सस्ती होने से निर्यात बढ़ता है और आयात महँगा होने से घटता है।) Exam Booster Facts: (1) India officially devalued the Rupee three times: 1949, 1966, and July 1991 (during the BoP crisis); (2) 'Depreciation' happens via market demand-supply under a floating exchange rate, while 'Devaluation' is an official policy action; (3) J-Curve effect explains how trade balance initially worsens after devaluation before improving; (4) India's Foreign Exchange Reserves are managed by the RBI.
qe: In international trade and monetary economics, 'Devaluation' of a domestic currency (under a fixed exchange rate regime) generally tends to:
oe: Make exports costlier and imports cheaper
Make exports cheaper for foreign buyers and imports costlier domestically
Reduce both exports and imports equally

q: समताप मंडल की ओज़ोन परत (O₃) के क्षरण के लिए मुख्य रूप से कौन-सी गैस उत्तरदायी है?
e: Chlorofluorocarbons (CFCs) release chlorine radicals in the stratosphere under UV radiation, catalytically destroying ozone (O₃) molecules. (क्लोरोफ्लोरोकार्बन (CFCs) समताप मंडल में क्लोरीन मुक्त मूलक छोड़कर ओज़ोन परत को नष्ट करते हैं।) Exam Booster Facts: (1) The Montreal Protocol (16 September 1987) is the landmark global treaty to phase out ozone-depleting substances (16 September = World Ozone Day); (2) Ozone thickness is measured in 'Dobson Units' (DU); (3) The Ozone Layer resides in the Stratosphere and absorbs harmful UV-B/UV-C radiation; (4) Kigali Amendment (2016) to the Montreal Protocol phases down Hydrofluorocarbons (HFCs).
qe: Which gas is primarily responsible for the depletion of the stratospheric Ozone Layer (O₃)?

q: भारत में नवजात शिशुओं को दिया जाने वाला 'BCG' टीका किस जीवाणुजनित रोग से सुरक्षा प्रदान करता है?
e: BCG (Bacillus Calmette–Guérin) protects infants against severe forms of Tuberculosis (TB), caused by the bacterium *Mycobacterium tuberculosis*. (BCG टीका नवजात शिशुओं को माइकोबैक्टीरियम ट्यूबरकुलोसिस जीवाणु से होने वाले क्षय रोग (TB) से बचाता है।) Exam Booster Facts: (1) DPT vaccine protects against three bacterial diseases: Diphtheria, Pertussis (Whooping Cough), and Tetanus; (2) India was declared Polio-free by WHO in March 2014; (3) World Tuberculosis Day is observed on 24 March (Robert Koch discovered TB bacillus in 1882); (4) India's National TB Elimination Programme aims to eliminate TB ahead of the global 2030 SDG target.
qe: Which vaccine-preventable bacterial disease is targeted by the 'BCG' vaccine administered to newborns in India?

q: डिजिटल इंडिया और शैक्षिक कंप्यूटिंग में 'URL' का पूर्ण रूप क्या है?
e: URL stands for 'Uniform Resource Locator'—the unique web address used to locate and retrieve a webpage or digital resource on the Internet. (URL का पूर्ण रूप 'यूनिफॉर्म रिसोर्स लोकेटर' है, जो इंटरनेट पर किसी वेबपेज या संसाधन का विशिष्ट पता होता है।) Exam Booster Facts: (1) HTML = HyperText Markup Language; HTTP = HyperText Transfer Protocol; DNS = Domain Name System; (2) Tim Berners-Lee invented the World Wide Web (WWW), HTTP, HTML, and URL at CERN in 1989; (3) IPv4 uses 32-bit addresses while IPv6 uses 128-bit addresses; (4) 'PDF' stands for Portable Document Format (created by Adobe).
qe: In Digital India and educational computing, what does 'URL' stand for?
